name: SLR-Bench-Dutch
description:
🧠 SLR-Bench-Dutch: Scalable Logical Reasoning Benchmark (Dutch Edition)
	





	
		
	
	
		SLR-Bench Multilingual Versions:
	








SLR-Bench-Dutch is the Dutch-language pendant of the original SLR-Benchdataset.
It follows the same symbolic structure, evaluation framework, and curriculum as the English version but provides all natural-language task prompts translated into Dutch.
This enables systematic evaluation and training of Large Language Models (LLMs) in logical reasoning in… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AIML-TUDA/SLR-Bench-Dutch.
reputation: An emerging multilingual variant of SLR-Bench used for evaluating logical reasoning in non-English LLMs, with growing interest but limited broad adoption so far.
